inputs.name: synapse_version
inputs.description: Tag of the ghcr.io/element-hq/synapse image, such as "v1.164.1".

inputs.name: server_name
inputs.description: The domain in every user ID and room alias, such as "example.com" for @alice:example.com. It can never change once Synapse has started with it.

inputs.name: public_baseurl
inputs.description: URL clients reach Synapse at through your reverse proxy, such as "https://matrix.example.com/".

inputs.name: listen_address
inputs.description: Address Synapse listens on. The default keeps it to the host itself, for a reverse proxy in front.

inputs.name: listen_port
inputs.description: Port Synapse serves the client and federation APIs on, in plain HTTP.

inputs.name: postgres
inputs.description: PostgreSQL to keep Synapse's data in, such as { host = "db1" }. The role and database must exist, the database with C collation. When null, Synapse uses SQLite in /var/lib/matrix-synapse, which is for trials only.

inputs.name: postgres_password
inputs.description: Password of the postgres username. Needed with postgres. Pass it at run time with -var or TF_VAR_postgres_password; it never reaches state or the plan.

inputs.name: admin_user
inputs.description: Localpart of an admin user to create, such as "admin" for @admin:SERVER_NAME. When null, no user is created.

inputs.name: admin_password
inputs.description: Password the admin user is created with. Needed with admin_user. Pass it at run time with -var or TF_VAR_admin_password; it never reaches state or the plan.

inputs.name: settings
inputs.description: Extra homeserver.yaml settings, merged over the circuit's at the top level, such as { enable_registration = true, registration_requires_token = true }.

inputs.name: image_digest
inputs.description: Digest of the image for synapse_version. Podman pulls by the digest, so change it with the version.
